content: Peer-group comparison is a named premium feature at multiple platforms: Stock Rover lets users compare same-sector companies side by side across income, growth, profitability, cash flow, analyst estimates, dividends, and computes fair value / margin of safety with quality+growth+value+sentiment sub-scores. Koyfin has peer comparison dashboards linking valuation multiples to fundamentals charts across peers. Simply Wall St instead uses per-company infographic snapshots and does not emphasize peer-vs-peer tabular comparison as strongly. This confirms peer/sector-relative comparison (vs whole-market comparison) is a recognized differentiator, not universal table stakes.
